text: It cleans clothes better then a full size washer.

If this Washer had a longer waste water hose, a longer (Add retractable- even better) power cord, and most importantly a more efficient means to hook it to most standard sinks (kitchen and baths) it would be GREAT! I was one of the luck it seems, as I figured how to connect my water hose to the vanity sink in just minutes. I attached WITHOUT any extra hardware or tools. But apparently, most people do not have the same setup. And that is unfortunate. I think most people using this will either wind up emptying the tub manually (due to both the length of the drainage hose and the lack of drainage options due to the gravity drainage system rather than a small pump) or filling the tub(s) manually (due to a lack of connection options) or both.

This is a very good washer overall. But, as I stated above, expect some manual operations (involving dirty and/or clean water- so dress appropriately) or be willing to spend some extra bucks to resolve its short comings.

I've been spoiled, I suppose, by the ease of the single-cup automatic coffee makers. But, they're not always eco-friendly. And, the coffee isn't always very fresh. Sometimes, I get gifts of coffee beans, or I just want to make a great cup of custom coffee, or I'm away from home with no maker in sight. Then, this paper-less pour-over coffee filter is perfect!

This pour-over coffee maker is perfect for the coffee afficionado who wants to have complete control over the temperature, grind, and mix of beans to water. The stainless steel is odorless and flavorless, so it won't interfere with the nuances of the coffee. If you're traveling, you don't need paper liners, either, so there's nothing else to bring with you, or worry about keeping dry. The mesh is so fine, there's no grounds in the bottom of my coffee cup, either!

Making a cup of coffee is as simple as heating some water, putting a scoop of grinds in the filter, wetting them, and then slowly pouring the rest of the water in. Make a cup, or make a carafe, it's up to you. My husband doesn't drink coffee (I know! and I still married him!) so I can use this to just make enough for me, just the way I like it.
(I received this product for review purposes. My opinions are my own. For more information and pictures, please see my blog, Lit From Within.)

I now have two primary methods of brewing coffee. My Keuig brewer and using this great pour over filter. I tried this new filter this morning to make my first pour over cup of coffee. There are plenty of good videos on YouTube on how to properly do pour over coffee, so I need not describe the process here other than to say that this product works perfectly. The Eco-Friendly Pour Over Coffee filter eliminates the need of a paper filter, so there is no chance of getting any residue from the filter into the coffee, even though the first step in preparing pour over is rinsing the filter with freshly boiled water to remove filter residue. There is no need of that with this filter. I did rinse my filter with hot water but only to warm the filter before placing the coffee into it.

Following the technique for preparing pour over coffee, I wound up with a perfectly brewed and filtered cup of hot coffee and absolutely no fines or residue in the cup. Yes, this will take longer than a quick Keurig brewed coffee, but well worth the time and effort! Preparing good pour over coffee becomes a joyful coffee experience.

After your coffee is brewed and ready to enjoy, the filter is very easy to clean. Just rinse the grounds down the drain and your done. I would highly recommend the Eco-Friendly Pour Over Dripper/filter.
Love it!  Perfect!  Top quality!  So glad I found it!

I would buy it again.

I'll stick with my Bodum Stainless Steel French Press.

I couldn't be happier, I'm really pleased when a product works as advertised and this one does.

I have always purchased the Maytag brand replacement filters for our refrigerator, and when I first started purchasing them, they were reasonably priced. I couldn't believe how expensive it was, and I couldn't spend that kind of money on a water filter.

I found several off-brand filters including this one. This was a great price for the filter, and I really only wanted to get one filter to try it first. I was nervous about putting something off-brand in the fridge that might cause problems or end up somehow ruining our very expensive refrigerator. It would be just my luck. However, knock on wood, we haven't had any issues with this off-brand replacement filter. It works fine, water tastes great, no leaks, or any other issues.
